design_notes: Use a single accent colour (e.g., deep blue) for table headers, pull-quote rule, and sidebar border.
Set all body text in a serif face (e.g., Georgia or Chronicle).
Tables: hairline rules between rows, a slightly heavier rule above the header and below the last row.
Pull-quote: set in a larger italic serif, with a thin rule on the left.
Sidebar: box with a thin border, background tint of the accent colour at 5% opacity.
No icons, no imagery, no decorative elements.
